name: Project Intelligence Toolkit
tagline: A research workspace for large capital projects: a sourced project database plus tools that test cost and schedule claims, draw lessons and track opportunity signals.
problem: Teams preparing a capital investment decision rely on cost and schedule figures for comparable projects that are scattered across news, filings and reports, and rarely traceable to a source. The toolkit keeps a project record (the Yard) where every datapoint carries a cited source, then runs analysis tools over it. It is built for consultants and analysts who need to defend each number in front of a client.
how: Sign in, then open the Yard: industries, a portfolio summary, a filterable dataset and per-project records with sourced fields.
Explore and Analysis views chart cost overrun against schedule overrun for the selected cohort, with filters by technology, EPC, lifecycle and country.
Reality Scan takes a scope (industry, project or company) and runs staged work: resolve scope, fetch sources, re-verify, calculate, finalize, synthesise and build a slide deck.
Lessons Learnt uses the same scope picker to derive evidence-backed lessons from sourced facts and builds a lessons deck.
Opportunity Map watches tracked clients and the general market for project signals, researches their locations and classifies them with a codebook.
Each run is stored with its stage log, so it can be replayed later as recorded work.
features: Yard project database with 19 industries, portfolio KPIs, CAPEX by phase and completion horizon
Dataset explorer with status, maturity, likelihood, confidence, plan and actual budget and delay
Cost overrun versus schedule overrun bubble chart and Gantt view
Project detail pages with tabs for ecosystem, milestones, delivery parties, technology, issues, scorecard, sources and lessons
Glossary, taxonomy, companies, sources and data quality admin views
Reality Scan pipeline with a research ledger and Excel workbook export
Lessons Learnt and Reality Scan slide deck builders (pptxgenjs)
Opportunity Map with signal filters, account tiles and a geography view
Guided demo mode that replays recorded runs
JWT login with rate limiting and an environment preflight report at /api/health/env
ai: An LLM extraction role pulls cost and schedule values from fetched source pages into evidence rows (llmExtractor).
A reasoning role writes the Reality Scan synthesis and names Lessons Learnt drivers.
Models are reached through OpenAI or a Portkey gateway; the default model string is @openai/gpt-4o-mini, set in one place (modelConfig.ts).
Web search for research runs and the Opportunity Map uses Tavily, SearchAPI or SerpAPI, with an RSS provider always on.
Without keys every model-gated write is a no-op and the UI states that AI or search is not configured.

stack.frontend: React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, TanStack Query, Recharts, wouter
stack.backend: Node.js, Express 5, TypeScript (esbuild), Zod, Orval-generated API client
stack.data: PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM; exceljs and pptxgenjs for exports
stack.ai: OpenAI or Portkey gateway (gpt-4o-mini default); Tavily, SearchAPI, SerpAPI for search

run:
pnpm install
createdb project_toolkit
pnpm run local:env -- --database-url postgres://USER:PASSWORD@localhost:5432/project_toolkit --username admin --password 'choose-a-password'
pnpm run db:schema
pnpm run db:seed
pnpm run dev   # open http://localhost:5173
notes: Ran locally exactly as the README describes, on a local PostgreSQL 16 with the bundled sample seed (20 nuclear projects, glossary, sources), with real login. The schema snapshot does not insert the Opportunity Map's default settings row, so the Opportunity Map returned 503 until that one INSERT from the repo's own migration 0011 was applied. No LLM or search keys exist here, so Reality Scan was run in Yard-only mode: the deterministic stages ran and synthesis failed with the app's own 'AI synthesis is unavailable' message, which is what the run screen shows. The guided demo replays need recorded runs that are not in the seed, and the Opportunity Map shows no signals without a search provider. Project detail pages exist only for the three fixture projects (p-003, p-007, p-010).
